item.title: Fijiana will focus on collisions against South Africa - Lomani
item.description: Vodafone Fijiana XVs Captain Kolora Lomani says they will be focusing on their collisions as South Africa is a strong team, that they are not taking lightly. Lomani stated this to the media after their Captain's run, saying the first 20 minutes they will be coming out hard to ensure that the Springboks do not walk over them.
item.content:encoded:
Vodafone Fijiana XVs Captain Kolora Lomani says they will be focusing on their collisions as South Africa is a strong team, that they are not taking lightly.

Lomani stated this to the media after their Captain's run, saying the first 20 minutes they will be coming out hard to ensure that the Springboks do not walk over them.

She says they will also be spreading the ball out wide when they can.

The Fijiana XV captain says they are looking forward to seeing their debutants in Adi Vani Buleki on the wing and Ruth Raketekete in the midfield play well tomorrow.

The last time the two sides met was at the Women's Rugby World Cup in 2022, where the Fijiana came out on top 21-17.

The Fijiana will host the Springboks Women at 2pm tomorrow at the HFC Bank Stadium.

The Marist Brothers High School Under-15 and Under-17 rugby teams will carry the hopes of the school into the Vodafone Super Deans Competition after receiving a special farewell yesterday.

In a show of sportsmanship and support for school rugby, Marist also released several Under-14 and Under-16 players to strengthen the squads of Nasinu Secondary School and Mahatma Gandhi Memorial High School for the national quarter-finals.

While speaking to fijivillage Sports school Head Teacher Asish Dayal s ays the players were keen to go and play as well.

item.title: We won't let the Springboks walk over us - Lomani
item.description: Vodafone Fijiana XV captain Kolora Lomani says her side is prepared for a fierce physical contest when they take on the Springbok Women in a historic Test match at HFC Bank Stadium tomorrow, saying that they will not let the Springboks Women "walk over us". Having not faced South Africa since the 2022 Rugby World Cup, Lomani says the Fijiana are under no illusions about the challenge that awaits.
item.content:encoded:
Vodafone Fijiana XV captain Kolora Lomani says her side is prepared for a fierce physical contest when they take on the Springbok Women in a historic Test match at HFC Bank Stadium tomorrow, saying that they will not let the Springboks Women "walk over us".

Having not faced South Africa since the 2022 Rugby World Cup, Lomani says the Fijiana are under no illusions about the challenge that awaits.

Insert: Lomani - Don't let them walk over us Aug 07

Lomani also welcomed the decision to stage the Test alongside girls' rugby fixtures, saying it would provide valuable inspiration for the next generation of players.

She says its very good exposure for rugby here in Fiji, to see the young girls coming in and the boys playing before and after them,and that it will be a good experience to see what it is like to be in that kind of environment.

The match will be the first time Fiji will host the South African women's national team.

The Fijiana team will face the South African team at 2pm at the HFC Bank Stadium in Suva.

item.content:encoded:
The battle for Cricket Fiji's 2026 Super 8 Championship title has officially begun, with the tournament draw held today and the eight qualifying teams discovering their group opponents.

Group A features Kabara, Lakeba, Moce and Namuka-i-Lau , while Group B consists of Suva, Nadi, Ono-i-Lau and Komo .

The championship will be held from 11th to 15th August at Albert Park in Suva , with free entry for spectators.

The Super 8 Championship will see the country's top teams compete for national honours over five days of competition.

item.title: Rewa FC focused ahead of OFC Men’s Champions League opener
item.description: Rewa FC is excited for its opening OFC Men’s Champions League match this Sunday as the team has settled well into the Western conditions and is building strong combinations. Assistant coach Priyant Mannu says the players are excited and focused as they prepare for the opening game, with the team working on key areas to ensure they are ready for the regional competition.
item.content:encoded:
Rewa FC is excited for its opening OFC Men’s Champions League match this Sunday as the team has settled well into the Western conditions and is building strong combinations.

Assistant coach Priyant Mannu says the players are excited and focused as they prepare for the opening game, with the team working on key areas to ensure they are ready for the regional competition.

He says the focus during training has been on maintaining composure in both attack and defence, especially when creating and finishing scoring opportunities.

Mannu says the team’s frontline will need to be clinical and make the most of the chances created during matches.

He says Rewa FC is grateful for the support from districts across Fiji as the side represents the country in the OFC Men’s Champions League.

Mannu adds with the tournament being hosted in Fiji, the support shown to the team has been encouraging.

He also expresses his appreciation to the Fiji Under-19 team for playing a friendly match against Rewa, saying the game provided an opportunity for the team to assess combinations among the players.

Mannu says that with a few new inclusions in the squad, the match helped the coaching staff identify areas that need further improvement before the tournament begins.

Rewa FC will open its OFC Men’s Champions League campaign this Sunday against Vanuatu’s Galaxy FC at 3pm at Churchill Park in Lautoka.

item.title: Ruth Raketekete and Adi Vani Buleki will debut for Fijiana against the Bokers
item.description: Ruth Raketekete and Adi Vani Buleki will make their debut for the Vodafone Fijiana XV against the South African Springbok Women tommorow. This has been confirmed by Fijiana Head Coach Willie Walker.
item.content:encoded:
Ruth Raketekete and Adi Vani Buleki will make their debut for the Vodafone Fijiana XV against the South African Springbok Women tommorow.

This has been confirmed by Fijiana Head Coach Willie Walker.

Walker says Raketekete will start at inside centre, while Buleki has been named on the wing.

He says halfback Kolora Lomani will captain the side, while prop Bitila Tawake has been named vice-captain.

In the forwards Karalaini Naisewa, Tiana Robanakadavu, Mereoni Nakesa, Karavaki Lutumaibau and Nunia Daunimoala, with Adi Salaseini Railumu and Alfreda Fisher strengthening the pack.

Varanisese Qoro gets the nod at flyhalf and will combine with Lomani in the halves, while Repeka Tove, Raketekete, Merewairita Neivoha, Buleki and Litiana Vueti complete the backline.

The impact players include Selai Naliva, Elesi Saukuru, Keri Lawavou, Vilisi Tivalele, Jade Coates, Evivi Senikarivi, Ivamere Nabura and Aqela Raitubu.

The Test marks Walker’s first match in charge of the national side and the beginning of a two-match series against South Africa, with the second encounter scheduled for next week at Churchill Park in Lautoka.

The Fijiana will face South Africa at 2pm at the HFC Bank Stadium tommorow.

item.title: RKS, Lelean and Grammar field teams in every grade
item.description: Navitalai Naivalurua · 06/08/2026 Three schools competing in the Vodafone Fiji Secondary Schools Rugby Union Super Deans Competition will field teams in every grade this year.
item.content:encoded:
Navitalai Naivalurua · 06/08/2026

Three schools competing in the Vodafone Fiji Secondary Schools Rugby Union Super Deans Competition will field teams in every grade this year.

They are Ratu Kadavulevu School, Lelean Memorial School and Suva Grammar School.

RKS are the defending Super Deans champions after defeating Nasinu Secondary School 53-15 in last year's final, while Lelean enter the national playoffs as the top qualifiers from the Eastern Zone.

Suva Grammar are the top team from the Southern Zone after successfully defending their title with a 29-22 win over Nasinu earlier this year.

The national quarterfinals will be played across four venues this weekend – Suva, Tavua, Vatukoula and Savusavu.

In the Under-18 quarter-finals, Lelean will face Ratu Navula College at 4.30pm, followed by Suva Grammar against Ba Provincial Free Bird Institute at 5.55pm, with both matches at the HFC Bank Stadium.

At Garvey Park in Tavua, Ra will take on RKS at 1.40pm, while Cuvu College will face Nasinu Secondary School at 3.05pm.
